fixed_challenger.role: one fixed incumbent-replacement challenger, not a lambda scan or minimum-prior claim

required_execution_order: finish and provenance-audit exactly 24 long-horizon starts
select and train one candidate central through 300000 requested capacity
finish and provenance-audit exactly 50 experimental replicas
construct the 1200-member centered-log-FNP start-by-replica product ensemble
complete the stratified nested-interaction validation and directional convergence envelopes
render final candidate Fig. 2 and Fig. 6 plus direct candidate-versus-incumbent comparisons
promote or reject lambda600 from the complete final result
only after that verdict decide the next controlled study

progress_snapshot.interpretation: timestamped operational progress only; it is not a lambda600-versus-lambda1 result and cannot change the incumbent

live_progress_observer.refresh: read-only observer scheduled every five minutes during the full24 stage
live_progress_observer.authoritative_decision_source: the terminal, audited full24 and final lambda600 evidence graph; never this live observer

final_uncertainty_semantics.central_line: audited trained 300000-capacity central and its paired transform, not an ensemble median
final_uncertainty_semantics.band: 24-by-50 product distribution plus directional convergence and nested-interaction envelopes
final_uncertainty_semantics.note: the final directional envelope is not labeled one sigma or 68 percent

post_verdict_scope.next: the broader dataset-identifiability and minimum-required-constraint objective continues after promotion or rejection; lambda600 becomes the new incumbent only if the locked complete-result gates pass
